issues: The page is missing an h1 element, which is crucial for defining the main topic and overall structure.
The heading hierarchy is illogical and skips levels (e.g., h2 followed by h5, h3 followed by h5), making it difficult to understand the page structure.
Empty heading elements (h5: "") are present, providing no semantic value and confusing screen reader users.
The heading "ЈСП Скопје" is used as an h3 multiple times and is too generic to describe specific sections, especially when not serving as the main page title.
Headings at the same level (h3) do not have comparable importance or parallel structure.
The h5 elements are used incorrectly, often duplicating parent headings or being empty, indicating a misuse of heading levels.
missingSections: The prominent "Важно известување" (Important announcement) section at the top of the page body text lacks a dedicated heading.
Content associated with the empty h5 headings likely needs proper, descriptive headings at the correct hierarchical level.
suggestions: Implement a single h1 element that clearly reflects the main topic of the page, such as "ЈСП Скопје – Ваш верен сопатник".
Correct the heading hierarchy to ensure no levels are skipped; headings should descend one level at a time (e.g., h2 followed by h3, not h5).
Remove all empty heading elements (h5: "") or populate them with descriptive text at the appropriate heading level.
Ensure all headings are descriptive and unique, avoiding generic or repetitive text like "ЈСП Скопје" unless it is the h1.
Re-evaluate the purpose of the h3: "ЈСП Скопје" headings and replace them with more specific section titles or remove them if redundant.
Add a descriptive heading (e.g., h2 or h3) for the "Важно известување" section at the top of the page.
Ensure headings at the same level have comparable importance and structure to provide a consistent navigation experience.
items.summary: The page has critical heading semantic issues, including a missing h1, incorrect hierarchy, empty headings, and vague or repetitive section titles, severely impacting navigation and understanding for screen reader users.
